title: Cartesian tensor square for normalized open base change
statement: For any normalized ringed open Cartesian square Operations o, Assertion a, and Data v as defined in [def-sf-clopen-comparison-tensor-data], the first Cartesian tensor identity in Equations a v holds for all unbounded H and N. Explicitly P_p(delta_i);beta;b_!(mu_q);b_!(1 tensor theta^{-1}) equals mu_p;(beta tensor 1);delta_b. No clopen property of the additional open s is used.

source.place: Tags 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product) and 0GL1 (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor); clopen tensor refinement of Stacks 0F7B, original steps 1–7.

proof.text: Transpose the inverse Cartesian square under the base-changed open adjunction. Substitute the specified beta and gamma inverse transposes. Naturality of theta moves it past gamma. Apply [lem-sf-clopen-pullback-tensor-compatibility] to the ambient tensor, and then tensor naturality. Naturality of the inverse restriction tensor comparison identifies the beta inverse factors. Finally cancel the gamma and beta isomorphisms to recover the forward Cartesian square.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product) and 0GL1 (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor); agent open-unit and clopen tensor refinement

from.place: Proof sentence: The composition, refinement, exchange and proper-coincidence identities are [prop-sf-pf-coherence]; clopen comparison tensor compatibility, original seven-step refinement.

lean.statement:
theorem cartesian_tensor {m : Mode} {d : Input.{u} m} {t : SiteSquare d}
    {o : Operations d t} (a : Assertion o) {A : Scheme.{u}}
    {s : A ⟶ d.U'} [IsOpenImmersion s] (v : Data o s) :
  ∀ (H : ProjectionRestriction.Der (restrictRing m d.j d.R))
      (N : ProjectionRestriction.Der d.R),
    o.gPull.derived.map (a.gamma.hom.app (H, N)) ≫
        a.beta.hom.app (o.tensorU.functor.obj (H, o.opens.jStar.obj N)) ≫
        o.opens.jShriek'.map (v.tensorQ.comparison.hom.app (H, o.opens.jStar.obj N)) ≫
        o.opens.jShriek'.map (o.tensorU'.functor.map
          (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) (o.theta.inv.app N))) =
      v.tensorP.comparison.hom.app (o.opens.jShriek.obj H, N) ≫
        o.tensorX'.functor.map (Prod.mkHom (a.beta.hom.app H) (𝟙 _)) ≫
        v.tensorB.delta.hom.app (o.gUPull.derived.obj H, o.gPull.derived.obj N)
